about: Cases on the installed game (1.19.4.1). Vanilla script loads in the game, so a validation error on a vanilla file is a false positive unless the game's own error.log reports the same line; such files are excluded with the reason.

cases.title: The first lookup of a vanilla event finds its definition
cases.evidence: events/PoliticalEvents.txt:9 holds id = political.1 inside the event that starts on line 8.

cases.title: A repeated vanilla lookup answers from the warm index
cases.evidence: Same as vanilla.source_lookup.cold-event.

cases.title: owner = ROOT in state scope is an error that names is_owned_by
cases.evidence: In-game check 2026-11-02 (run26, 1.19.4.1, vanilla plus a probe mod): owner = ROOT, owner = GER and owner = SOV inside a state-scope limit each log "Invalid trigger 'owner'" and "Unknown trigger-type: owner" at load, and all three limits then pass, the SOV one included. The plan read common/decisions/_documentation.md:43 as allowing it; the game does not.

cases.title: owner = GER in state scope is an error that names is_owned_by
cases.evidence: In-game check 2026-11-02 (run26, 1.19.4.1, vanilla plus a probe mod): owner = ROOT, owner = GER and owner = SOV inside a state-scope limit each log "Invalid trigger 'owner'" and "Unknown trigger-type: owner" at load, and all three limits then pass, the SOV one included.

cases.title: A numeric comparison with a dynamic variable is still an error
cases.evidence: num_owned_states is documented as a dynamic variable; comparing it with > outside check_variable needs the trigger of the same name, which takes a number. owner > 3 has no meaning.

cases.title: A wrong idea id inside add_timed_idea is caught
cases.evidence: No idea named bench_no_such_idea exists in vanilla; GER_mefo_bills_1 does (common/ideas/GER.txt:1313).

cases.title: A real idea id inside add_timed_idea passes
cases.evidence: GER_mefo_bills_1 is defined at common/ideas/GER.txt:1313.

cases.title: The probability adapters are verified for the installed 1.19.4.1 build
cases.evidence: launcher-settings.json reports Operation Postern v1.19.4.1.99a5 (f584); the adapters are pinned to 1.19.2.0 (d245).

cases.title: The exact name add_timed_idea is the first hit
cases.evidence: The installed effects documentation has a section named add_timed_idea.

cases.title: The exact name has_war_with is the first hit
cases.evidence: The installed triggers documentation has a section named has_war_with.

cases.title: A query for something that does not exist returns nothing
cases.evidence: No document mentions zzqx_imaginary_command.

cases.title: infantry_weapons is explained with what it leads to
cases.evidence: common/technologies/infantry.txt:16 defines infantry_weapons with leads_to_tech = infantry_weapons1.

cases.title: Brandenburg is found as state 64
cases.evidence: history/states/64-Brandenburg.txt.

cases.title: Vanilla event files raise no validation errors
cases.evidence: Vanilla event files load in 1.19.4.1.

cases.title: Vanilla decision files raise no validation errors
cases.evidence: Vanilla decision files load in 1.19.4.1.

cases.title: Vanilla focus files raise no validation errors
cases.evidence: Vanilla national focus files load in 1.19.4.1.

knownErrors.evidence: The 1.19.4.1 file has 101 opening and 102 closing braces; the last line closes a block that was never opened. The game skips the stray brace, so the file still loads.

cases.title: Vanilla scripted effects, triggers and on_actions raise no validation errors
cases.evidence: These vanilla files load in 1.19.4.1.

cases.title: One key in all ten vanilla languages, answered inline
cases.evidence: AAT_Sweden.21.t is defined in localisation/<language>/aat_events_l_<language>.yml for braz_por, english, french, german, japanese, korean, polish, russian, simp_chinese and spanish (1.19.4.1).

cases.title: A key only one language needs is not missing from the others
cases.evidence: ABK_SOV_communism_subject_ADJ_RU_lower is a Russian grammar key defined only in localisation/russian/RU_LOCKEYS_l_russian.yml:15908 (1.19.4.1).

cases.title: An idea comes back with its picture, modifiers and name in every language, inline
cases.evidence: GER_mefo_bills_1 is defined at common/ideas/GER.txt:1313 with name = GER_mefo_bills and picture = ger_mefo_bills (GFX_idea_ger_mefo_bills in interface/ideas.gfx); production_speed_arms_factory_factor is built from the arms_factory building. The head-to-head found HOI4-MCP missing this idea.

cases.title: An organization comes back with its include, traits, pictures and names, inline
cases.evidence: GER_porsche_organization (common/military_industrial_organization/organizations/GER_organization.txt:18) includes generic_heavy_tank_organization and adds traits such as GER_mio_trait_hoesch_facilities, named in localisation by their token. Its icon GFX_idea_porsche is defined in interface/ideas.gfx.

cases.title: The game's own on_actions report nothing, including hooks the documentation omits
cases.evidence: 00_on_actions.txt uses on_add_history and on_units_paradropped_in_state, which common/on_actions/_documentation.md (updated 2024-11) does not list. Both are in hoi4.exe.

cases.title: The game's special projects, rewards and specializations report nothing
cases.evidence: Reward options without localisation (for example sp_land_reward_option_land_cruiser_overheating in land_projects.txt:460) are the only option of their reward, so the game never shows a choice between them.

cases.title: A balance of power's decision category is not reported missing
cases.evidence: common/bop/SWE.txt:6 sets decision_category = SWE_riksdag_balance_of_power_category, which no file in common/decisions/categories defines, and common/decisions/SWE.txt files decisions under it: the balance creates it.

cases.title: A template with two regiments in one designer slot is reported
cases.evidence: history/units/CZE_1936.txt:43-44: the template "Jezdecká brigáda" places two cavalry regiments at x = 0, y = 2 (vanilla 1.19.4.1).

expect.includes: `cavalry` and `cavalry` both sit at x = 0, y = 2 in regiments

cases.title: Equipment a duplicate_archetypes copy derives counts as defined
cases.evidence: common/units/equipment/x_plane_airframes.txt:8 copies small_plane_airframe as small_plane_cas_airframe, so small_plane_airframe_0 gives small_plane_cas_airframe_0, which history/units/ARG_1936_air_bba.txt:12 uses.

cases.title: A variant is found by its name in country history, every time it is created
cases.evidence: history/countries/GER - Germany.txt creates the variant "Königsberg" twice: at line 1069 as light_cruiser_1 (without Man the Guns) and at line 1304 as ship_hull_cruiser_1 with modules. The answer checks the last one.

cases.title: A ship hull with fixed and copied module slots has no problem
cases.evidence: common/units/equipment/ship_hull_light.txt: ship_hull_light lists module_slots with allowed_module_categories that modules in common/units/equipment/modules name as their category.
